findings: File_30 binds model 0x23F and animation 0xE; entity identity remains 0x354. At old timer 30, immutable word +0xD0 equal to one creates an effect and category-6 entity 0xFC; zero disables emission. The loop has no existing-child guard. The common child setup gives one HP at byte +0x8D. Base flags are 0x002E8261 plus local shadow bit 0x08000000 only when shadow allocation succeeds. The sole continuation func_08001FF4_6D10D4 advances a finite route with four movement legs and no timeout, then removes the actor without a death reward. Several generations may overlap. Route +0xC4, timer +0xC6, origin +0xC8/+0xCA/+0xCC, substate +0xCE, PC +0xCF, facing +0xAA and status bit 0x400 are scalar state. Pointer +0x9C is the local actor itself; shadow and display lists remain local.

func_80218350_5D3820 calls func_80218548_5D3A18 immediately when damage reaches zero HP; a return hook runs after death and loot side effects. For the dynamic route-57 robot, an accepted ordinary hit requires status +0x68 bit 0x80, non-null local hitter +0x38 and clear status bit 1. Fast damage uses status bit 0x40000 and subtracts one HP first. Native surviving-hit bookkeeping clears 0x80, sets status bit 1 and byte +0x8C to 60. Fast death ignores +0x90, sets removal bit 2, and rolls at most one coin or health child. Word +0x64 bit 0x8000 suppresses only loot. Route completion bypasses this death path.
